name.ja: 1/700スケール　東京スカイツリー®

description.ja: • プラモデルだから実現した、本物と変わらぬこだわりの造形。全高905mm。
description.en: • Because it is a plastic model, it is made with the same attention to detail as the real thing. Overall height 905mm.

description.ja: • 高さ634ｍの鉄塔を支える複雑な鉄骨のトラス構造。鉄骨の太さや組み合わせの形状を可能な限り再現。
description.en: • A complex steel truss structure that supports a 634m high steel tower. The thickness of the steel frame and the shape of the combination are reproduced as much as possible.

description.ja: • 第一展望台、第二展望台、空中回廊、ゲイン塔など、複雑な形状を細部まで表現。
description.en: • Complex shapes such as the first observation deck, second observation deck, aerial corridor, and gain tower are expressed in detail.

description.ja: • 綿密な取材に基づき、さまざまなライティングイメージを31個のLEDで再現。ライティングユニットは組み立て済み。
description.en: • Based on detailed research, various lighting images are reproduced with 31 LEDs. The lighting unit has been assembled.

description.ja: • 建造途中を演出できる特別アイテムとして、タワークレーンが付属。
description.en: • A tower crane is included as a special item that can be used to show the construction process in progress.
